column1: # The labelling batch manifest (content free: no excerpt, no finding). One row per packet batch per
# side: the reviewer id (listed in labellers.tsv), the id of the fresh agent run that labelled the
# batch (one agent per batch per side, never shared), the batch's packet count and the sha256 of its
# packet id list (one id per line). `seccorpus labels` refuses a label file whose batch is not here.
# isolation is the labelling harness's to set (attested), never a labeller's; no harness attests it yet, so it
# stays -, and a measurement whose passes agree on every verdict and reason code is one effective pass.
